leaves.name: afTateCharPolyPicZero
leaves.doc: isj1-dict: Eichler-Shimura for A_f over J_1(N) = Pic^0(X_1(N)), existence form of Diamond-Shurman Lemma 9.5.3 and Thm 9.5.4 at one model. For N >= 1 and a newform f in S_2(Gamma_1(N)) with nebentypus chi there is a model X of X_1(N) over Q (IsX1Model) such that for the degree-zero Picard scheme Pic^0_{X/Q} (any representing abelian variety V with the tensor group law, vendored Jacobian-Challenge library) there are a Q-quotient pi : V ->> A and theta : K_f -> End^0(A) with V_l(A) free of rank 2 over Q_l (x) K_f and the characteristic polynomial of arithmetic Frobenius at p not dividing N*l equal to X^2 - a_p X + chi(p) p. Replaces r16CoreY together with x1PointsConjugate (the curve/function-field step is proved: R16IsJ1Dict.curveIsoOfFunctionFieldIso_proof): Pic^0 = Albanese (every IsJ1 Jacobian is Pic^0), base-point independence and the transfer to every IsJ1 Jacobian are proved (R16IsJ1Dict.afTateCharPoly_of_picZero); conversely it follows from r16-used's AfTateCharPoly and X1ModelExists (afTateCharPolyPicZero_of_afTate). If DS 9.5.4 prints only that Frobenius satisfies the equation, R16IsJ1Dict.AfTateWeakOddPicZero (weak relation + oddness on each iota-component) discharges the field too (r16CoreY_of_dict).
leaves.flag: unread: new printed leaf (DS 9.5.3 + 9.5.4 at Pic^0 of one model); dictionary step: the print is for Diamond-Shurman's X_1(N)_alg, function field Q(j, f_1) (Weber function), identified with the kernel's K_N = Q(j)(x(P)) through DS 7.5-7.7 / Shimura 1971 Ch. 6 (not statable in Lean: no f_1); DS 9.5.4 wording (characteristic polynomial vs equation) unread, fallback AfTateWeakOddPicZero; locators UNVERIFIED
leaves.source: Diamond-Shurman, A First Course in Modular Forms, GTM 228 (2005): 6.6 (A_f), 7.7 (X_1(N)_alg, J_1(N) = Pic^0), Lemma 9.5.3, Thm 9.5.4; Shimura 1971 Thms 7.9-7.14; numbers UNVERIFIED (unread)

leaves.name: x1PointsConjugate
leaves.doc: isj1-dict: Igusa. For N >= 1 and points P, P' of exact order N of E_j over an algebraic closure of Q(j), some sigma in Aut(Q(j)bar/Q(j)) maps x(P) to x(P'). Consequence of the printed Gal(Q(j)(E[N])/Q(j)) = GL_2(Z/N) (Gal(F_N/Q(j)) = GL_2(Z/N)/{+-1} on Weber functions) and the transitivity of SL_2(Z/N) on vectors of order N; any two Weierstrass models over Q(j) with invariant j differ by a twist and x -> u^2 x + r over Q(j). False for N = 0 (hence 0 < N).
leaves.flag: consequence of the printed theorem (Galois group GL_2(Z/N), resp. GL_2(Z/N)/{+-1} on x-coordinates); locator UNVERIFIED
leaves.source: Igusa, Amer. J. Math. 81 (1959); Shimura 1971, Thm 6.6; Lang, Elliptic Functions, Ch. 6 section 3; Diamond-Shurman section 7.5; numbers UNVERIFIED
